Server.MOTD: Welcome to the Rec Room private server!

DorkNet._comment_SupportedVersions: Per-deployment allow-list. Requests whose X-DorkNet-Version header isn't in this set get a 426 Upgrade Required. To accept multiple client builds add their keys here.
DorkNet._comment_DefaultClientVersion: Fallback for requests without an X-DorkNet-Version header — the transition path while not every shipped client mod yet stamps the header. Set to '' (empty) once everyone's caught up to also reject headerless calls.
DorkNet._comment_BuildIdToVersionKey: Maps the raw build identifier the 2020 watch sends to /api/versioncheck/v4?v={buildId} (read from KMJJGELKNAP.MCFMPCNNEBH, e.g. '20201210') to our internal ClientVersion.Key. Builds not listed here get UpdateRequired and the watch shows its native dialog. Add a new build by listing its raw ID + matching version-plugin key.
